guard: Every selected fixture executes on one configured shard; the aggregate changed check rejects failure, cancellation and skipping. Every child launched by the smoke excludes inherited COTAL_ variables, and an empty shard reports only its own assignment.

mutations.name: every shard executes the full selected set
mutations.find: if (shard) selected = selected.filter(({ path }) => shardOf(path, Number(shard[2])) === Number(shard[1]));
mutations.replace: if (false && shard) selected = selected.filter(({ path }) => shardOf(path, Number(shard[2])) === Number(shard[1]));
mutations.expectRed: fixture shards partition the selected set without omission or overlap
mutations.cell: fixture shards partition the selected set without omission or overlap

mutations.name: all fixtures collapse onto shard zero
mutations.expectRed: the partition control exercises every configured shard with a discriminating fixture
mutations.cell: the partition control exercises every configured shard with a discriminating fixture

mutations.name: the workflow omits the runner shard argument
mutations.expectRed: the changed workload runs every configured shard without fail-fast cancellation
mutations.cell: the changed workload runs every configured shard without fail-fast cancellation

mutations.name: one configured shard is missing
mutations.expectRed: the changed workload runs every configured shard without fail-fast cancellation
mutations.cell: the changed workload runs every configured shard without fail-fast cancellation

mutations.name: a failed shard cancels its sibling work
mutations.expectRed: the changed workload runs every configured shard without fail-fast cancellation
mutations.cell: the changed workload runs every configured shard without fail-fast cancellation

mutations.name: the aggregate is skipped after a shard fails
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate changed check waits for all shards even after a failed or cancelled shard
mutations.cell: the aggregate changed check waits for all shards even after a failed or cancelled shard

mutations.name: the aggregate no longer waits on the matrix
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate changed check waits for all shards even after a failed or cancelled shard
mutations.cell: the aggregate changed check waits for all shards even after a failed or cancelled shard

mutations.name: the aggregate accepts failed shards
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate shell rejects shard result failure
mutations.cell: the aggregate shell rejects shard result failure

mutations.name: the aggregate accepts cancellation
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate shell rejects shard result cancelled
mutations.cell: the aggregate shell rejects shard result cancelled

mutations.name: the aggregate accepts a skipped shard set
mutations.expectRed: the aggregate shell rejects shard result skipped
mutations.cell: the aggregate shell rejects shard result skipped

mutations.name: the common smoke child environment keeps Cotal session variables
mutations.find: for (const key of Object.keys(env)) if (key.startsWith("COTAL_")) delete env[key];
mutations.expectRed: aggregate probes do not inherit Cotal session credentials
mutations.cell: aggregate probes do not inherit Cotal session credentials

mutations.name: the scanner bypasses the sanitized child environment
mutations.find: const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, args, { encoding: "utf8", env: childEnv() });
mutations.expectRed: fixture children do not inherit Cotal session credentials
mutations.cell: fixture children do not inherit Cotal session credentials

mutations.name: git bypasses the sanitized child environment
mutations.expectRed: git children do not inherit Cotal session credentials
mutations.cell: git children do not inherit Cotal session credentials

mutations.name: aggregate probes bypass the sanitized child environment
mutations.expectRed: aggregate probes do not inherit Cotal session credentials
mutations.cell: aggregate probes do not inherit Cotal session credentials

mutations.name: an empty shard claims there is no global diff intersection
mutations.expectRed: an empty shard reports its own assignment without claiming a globally empty diff
mutations.cell: an empty shard reports its own assignment without claiming a globally empty diff
